extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for creating a new Wikipedia article or troubleshooting a missing-title page, covering account/autoconfirmation requirements, searching for existing content, visibility delays, capitalization/redirects, and deleted-page checks.

rubrics_metrics.name: Account and autoconfirmation requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: You need to log in or create an account and be autoconfirmed to create new articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Alternatively, you can use the article wizard to submit a draft for review, or request a new article.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search for existing coverage / alternative titles
rubrics_metrics.description: Search for "Comedy addiction" in existing articles. Look for pages within Wikipedia that link to this title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Check for alternative titles or spellings before creating a new page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recently created pages may not be visible immediately
rubrics_metrics.description: If a page was recently created here, it may not be visible yet because of a delay in updating the database.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Wait a few minutes or try the purge function to refresh the database view.

rubrics_metrics.name: Title case-sensitivity and redirects
rubrics_metrics.description: Titles on Wikipedia are case sensitive except for the first character; please check alternative capitalizations and consider adding a redirect here to the correct title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If the correct title differs only by capitalization, add or request a redirect rather than creating a duplicate article.

rubrics_metrics.name: Deleted-page check and deletion log
rubrics_metrics.description: If the page has been deleted, check the deletion log, and see "Why was the page I created deleted?"
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Review deletion reasons in the log before attempting to recreate content; follow Wikipedia's deletion guidance to avoid repeat deletions.
